title: La iglesia
goal: Get into a church that is shut, and be told why
culture: The old churches are locked between services because they have been robbed. The sacristán is not turning you away — he is telling you the hour to come back, and if you take it he will let you in and tell you what you are looking at.

beats.en: It’s closed? What time does it open?
ok: esta cerrado a que hora abre
beats.good: Está cerrado is a fact, not a refusal. The next question is always the hour, and he is expecting you to ask it.

beats.es: A las cinco, para la misa. Antes no.
beats.good: Hours here are said plainly and meant loosely, except for mass, which starts when it says it will.

beats.es: Venga después de la misa y se la enseño toda.
beats.en: I’ll come afterwards. That’s very kind.
beats.good: He says venga, you say vengo — the same trip from the two ends of it. Turning his invitation into your plan is what gets you the tour.

beats.es: Ahí lo espero, pues. Con permiso.
beats.good: Con permiso is how you leave, how you pass somebody in a doorway and how you interrupt. Not saying it is the rudest thing a quiet person can do here.
